entities.name: Marek Výborný
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marek Výborný is a Czech politician, who served as the Czech Minister of Agriculture in Cabinet of Petr Fiala from 2023 to 2025. He has been serving as the leader of KDU-ČSL since October 2024. He was also the leader of KDU-ČSL between 2019 and 2020. Výborný resigned on the post on 19 November 2019 after his wife died and he became a single parent for his three children. He left the position on 25 January 2020.
